integrity: Analytic gap-simplex and overlap proof; standalone standard-library finite checker, which does not certify asymptotics; literature priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Intrinsic nonpositively curved Euclidean cones with independent uniform azimuths, positive radii and each fixed clique order; no claim about nonuniform angular laws or varying clique order.
title: A Poisson hierarchy for geodesic cliques through a Euclidean cone apex
